body: Adds a way to let the user specify how to do the complete rendering of the hits. FIX #771

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @vvo, @Jerskouille and @pixelastic to be potential reviewers
I like `items`, but maybe that's because Rails uses a lot singular/plural forms.

@Jerskouille I tried `items` but given that it's the same level of usage (both parameters of templates and both are valid attributes) it's likely to generate mistakes which are hard to find and debug.

> @Jerskouille I tried items but given that it's the same level of usage (both parameters of templates and both are valid attributes) it's likely to generate mistakes which are hard to find and debug.

I don't get why `allItems` would be better than `items` then?
It's more possible to not see a missing `s` than `all...s`
Oh ok. I, also, am used to the Rails conventions so quite used to spot that :)
I am also used to spot that. But I got bitten the other day, and I don't like that :P

title: feat(hits): adds allItems template as an alternative to item
